title: Cross-platform beta: three systems, installers, savings estimate and two languages
planning_assumption: Plan to v1.0.0 (Codex only) approved in chat on 2026-10-14. The user chose on 2026-10-14: user prices in router.toml, all data in ~/.roudex, NSIS + universal DMG + deb + AppImage, and the system language with a selector that the hook follows. Tasks run outside the coordinator (D8) and declare tier instead of profile/model/effort, so the validator's routed-field warnings are expected. The user approved this spec and all ten tasks in chat on 2026-10-14.

execution_policy.coordinator: none: implemented directly outside the coordinator (AGENTS.md, decision D8)
execution_policy.network_scope: Installing @tauri-apps/cli and the bundler tooling Tauri downloads (R005-T007), and GitHub Actions runs (R005-T008). Nothing else.
execution_policy.framework_or_dependency_changes: @tauri-apps/cli as a ui dev dependency (approved in the plan to v1.0.0). No new Rust crates and no new runtime dependencies.

milestones.title: Beta multiplataforma
exit_criteria: Every task completed with verify evidence.
Every scenario has evidence in acceptance-evidence.md, including the Windows installer smoke test with real Codex (A17) and the macOS/Linux CI evidence (A18).
Manifests at 0.9.0, CI green on main, signed tag and a release with the four installers attached.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A new install on Windows, macOS or Linux with no RouDex data.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Open the app, use the chat and the CLI.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: router.toml, router.sqlite3 and the hook files live in ~/.roudex (or $ROUDEX_HOME); nothing is written next to the working directory.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test --workspace on the three CI systems

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Windows with v0.8.0 data in %LOCALAPPDATA%\RouDex and no ~/.roudex/router.sqlite3.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Start the app or any CLI command; start it again.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Threads, tasks and router.toml appear in ~/.roudex; the originals are unchanged; the second start copies nothing; existing ~/.roudex data is never overwritten.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test --workspace (Windows); real migration in R005-T010

acceptance_scenarios.action: Run the app, the CLI and the hook.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: All of them read and write only there.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Codex installed only through its desktop app (macOS layouts, Windows copies) or only on PATH or ~/.local/bin; codex_path set in router.toml.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Start a chat or a task.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: RouDex finds the binary in the documented order; codex_path wins over automatic discovery and ROUDEX_CODEX_BIN over both.

acceptance_scenarios.action: Start a chat or run router-cli models.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: A clear error lists the places tried and how to set codex_path; no process is spawned.

acceptance_scenarios.action: Press Instalar hook in Resumen; press it again.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: router-cli is copied from the app folder to ~/.roudex/bin, hooks.json gets one RouDex entry, the second press changes nothing, and the card shows the hook as installed.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: Windows installer smoke recorded in acceptance-evidence.md

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: The app running from source, without a bundled router-cli.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Instalar hook is unavailable and explains how to use router-cli hook-install.

acceptance_scenarios.action: Run it manually; publish a release.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Windows, macOS and Linux jobs produce the NSIS installer, the universal DMG, the deb and the AppImage; on a published release they are attached to it; the Linux app starts under xvfb.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Chat and task turns of the last 30 days and prices for their models and for the fuerte model.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Cost, cost at fuerte, savings and router overhead match the D5 formula; turns without prices are counted apart; the card says it is an estimate.
No money is shown; tokens by tier and the snippet to add prices are.
The classifier's own tokens are recorded and subtracted as router overhead.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: include_codex_desktop enabled and rollout files with Codex Desktop turns, some of them RouDex threads.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Open Resumen twice; change one file.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Codex Desktop appears as its own source with model and token totals; RouDex threads are not counted twice; no message text is stored; the second read skips unchanged files.
Every screen changes language at once, dates and numbers follow it, and the choice survives a restart.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: Browser fixture in both languages; untranslated-literal check

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A first start with no language in router.toml.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Open the app on an English and on a Spanish system.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: The app starts in the system language and stores it in router.toml without changing any other line.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: language set to en, to es, and unset.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Send a risky prompt in Codex Desktop through the hook.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: The context and the warning line are in English, Spanish and English respectively.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: The Windows installer from the release workflow and real Codex.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Install, migrate v0.8.0 data, chat, run the example spec, install the hook, uninstall.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Everything works without administrator rights and the data survives the uninstall.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: macOS and Linux without a physical machine.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Run the CI and the release workflow.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Tests pass on both systems, the installers are produced and the Linux app starts under xvfb; the release notes state that macOS and Linux were verified in CI only.

tasks.title: RouDex data in ~/.roudex on every OS
tasks.prompt: Move router.toml, router.sqlite3 and everything the hook keeps to one home: $ROUDEX_HOME or ~/.roudex (D1). Add a paths module in router-core used by RouterStore::default_path, RouterConfig::default_path and desktop_hook. On Windows, when the new store is absent and %LOCALAPPDATA%\RouDex\router.sqlite3 exists, copy the database with SQLite's backup API and copy router.toml, never touching the originals and never overwriting existing data; report what was migrated. Switch tests from LOCALAPPDATA to ROUDEX_HOME. Implement only the declared scope. Do not read environment files or other repositories, publish, or grant approvals. Stop with a concrete blocked reason if a requirement cannot be met.
tasks.approval_requirements: The user approves this spec in chat before any task starts; that approval covers implementation, local verification and merging each PR once CI is green. Tagging and the release follow the phase close (R005-T010).
acceptance: A01-A03 hold on Windows, macOS and Linux (CI).
Tests isolate state with ROUDEX_HOME; none depends on LOCALAPPDATA except the Windows migration tests.
evidence: Executed outside the coordinator at the user's request (AGENTS.md, decision D8); route_id and run_id stay null.
router-core paths module: home() ($ROUDEX_HOME, else .roudex in USERPROFILE/HOME), store_path, config_path; RouterStore, RouterConfig and the Desktop hook use it.

Windows migration from LOCALAPPDATA/RouDex with VACUUM INTO into a temporary file then rename; originals untouched, existing files never overwritten; run by the app before opening the store and by every CLI command except hook.

cargo test --workspace: 129 passed (paths::tests x3, task_cli::state_lives_in_dot_roudex_in_the_user_folder, task_cli::data_from_before_0_9_is_copied_once_and_left_in_place); clippy -D warnings and fmt clean; pnpm --dir ui build passes.
